module: Provides the "option helpers" of the multiplayer settings. Each helper has a set(value) function that forwards the setting to the matching multiplayer_* extension if it is loaded. Used by core_settings_settings to link the mp* options to their extensions.
notes: The get functions are commented out in the code: only set functions exist.
Each set checks that the target extension (multiplayer_nametags, multiplayer_vehicleSync, multiplayer_multiplayer, multiplayer_sessionManager) exists before writing.

buildOptionHelpers.desc: Builds and returns the helpers table. Keys: mpNametagsEnabled (multiplayer_nametags.nametagsEnabled), mpNametagDistance (multiplayer_nametags.nametagDistance), mpEnableSwitchingToPlayerVehicles (multiplayer_vehicleSync.enableSwitchingToPlayerVehicles(value)), mpDebugMode (multiplayer_multiplayer.debugMode), mpUseCustomServiceURL (multiplayer_sessionManager.useCustomServiceURL), mpCustomServiceURL (multiplayer_sessionManager.customServiceURL).
